BLUE = (0, 0, 255)

RED = (255, 0, 0)

GREEN = (0, 255, 0)

# Clock

clock = pygame.time.Clock()

# Player class

class Player(pygame.sprite.Sprite):

    def __init__(self):

        super().__init__()

        self.image = pygame.Surface((40, 40))

        self.image.fill(BLUE)

        self.rect = self.image.get_rect()

        self.rect.center = (WIDTH//2, HEIGHT - 50)

        self.vel_y = 0

        self.jumping = False

    def update(self, platforms):

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()

        dx = 0

        dy = 0

        

        # Movement

        if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:

            dx = -5

        if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:

            dx = 5

        

        # Gravity

        self.vel_y += 1

        dy += self.vel_y

        

        # Ground collision

        if self.rect.bottom + dy > HEIGHT - 50:

            dy = HEIGHT - 50 - self.rect.bottom

            self.jumping = False

        

        # Platform collision

        for platform in platforms:

            if self.rect.colliderect(platform.rect):

                if self.vel_y > 0 and self.rect.bottom < platform.rect.top:

                    dy = platform.rect.top - self.rect.bottom

                    self.jumping = False

                elif self.vel_y < 0 and self.rect.top > platform.rect.bottom:

                    dy = platform.rect.bottom - self.rect.top

                    self.vel_y = 0

        

        self.rect.x += dx

        self.rect.y += dy

    def __init__(self, x, y, width, height):

        super().__init__()

        self.image = pygame.Surface((width, height))

        self.image.fill(GREEN)

        self.rect = self.image.get_rect()

        self.rect.x = x

        self.rect.y = y

        self.image.fill(RED)

        self.rect = self.image.get_rect()

        self.rect.center = (x, y)

        self.direction = 1  # 1 for right, -1 for left

        self.speed = 2

    def update(self, player):

        # Basic AI: patrol back and forth

        self.rect.x += self.speed * self.direction

        

        # Reverse direction if hitting walls

        if self.rect.left <= 0 or self.rect.right >= WIDTH:

            self.direction *= -1

        

        # Simple chasing behavior

        if abs(self.rect.centery - player.rect.centery) < 100:

            if self.rect.centerx < player.rect.centerx:

                self.direction = 1

            else:
